title: Xenon fluorides: identifying P, Q and R and testing their geometries
summary: Set the Xe:F2 ratio, temperature and pressure to make XeF4, push it to XeF6 with O2F2 and hydrolyse that to XeO3, then count lone pairs on a rotatable 3D model to test each printed statement.
subject: Chemistry
subtopics: Preparation of xenon fluorides and the role of the Xe:F2 ratio
VSEPR and steric number from valence-electron counting
Complete versus partial hydrolysis of XeF6
concepts: Lone pairs come from valence electrons left over after bonding
Steric number 7 cannot give a perfect octahedron
The fluorine-to-xenon ratio selects which fluoride forms
Hydrolysis substitutes without changing the oxidation state
A high oxidation state held by fluorine makes a fluorinating agent
formulas: steric number = bond pairs + lone pairs

methods: Every geometry derived by one routine from valence-electron counting rather than recalled: XeF4 gives 2 lone pairs, XeF6 gives 1, XeO3 gives 1, applied identically in all three cases
Each step balanced element by element: Xe + 2F2 -> XeF4; XeF4 + O2F2 -> XeF6 + O2; XeF6 + 3H2O -> XeO3 + 6HF
Fluorine bookkeeping on the second step forces XeF6: 4 F from XeF4 plus 2 F from O2F2
Oxidation-state ladder checked: +4 -> +6 -> +6, confirming the O2F2 step is the only redox step and that hydrolysis is a substitution
Statement (B) refuted geometrically rather than by assertion: perfect octahedral requires steric number 6 with zero lone pairs, and XeF6 has steric number 7
Preparation conditions cross-checked against the standard recipes: 2:1 at 673 K / 1 bar gives XeF2, 1:5 at 873 K / 7 bar gives XeF4, 1:20 at 573 K / 60-70 bar gives XeF6
The XeF4 + O2F2 reaction at 143 K confirmed against independent sources as the standard preparation of XeF6
Literature cross-check on the shapes: XeF4 square planar (D4h), XeF6 distorted octahedral (fluxional C3v), XeO3 trigonal pyramidal with O-Xe-O about 103 degrees
Answer derived independently first, then cross-checked against a published answer key and worked solution for this paper, which agree on (A), (C) and (D)

Headless-browser run of the finished page: 47 assertions covering every control, both product-selection boundaries, the full chain with atom ledgers, all four molecule models, the fluorinating assay, the gate, predictions, theme toggle, clean console and zero horizontal overflow at 390 px and 360 px
verification.note: IIT Roorkee's official key was not retrievable; the published key used for cross-checking is a coaching-institute key that agrees with the independent derivation in every respect.
